author: Apple
description:
One song. In one night. Created live on the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch.

Multiplatinum artist Labrinth transformed Apple Tower Theatre into his personal studio for the night, experimenting with new ways of making music on the new MacBook Pro.

See how Touch opens up a world of creative possibilities in Logic Pro 13: shaping EQ envelopes, manipulating samples, tweaking Remix FX, and even playing keys right onscreen.

Learn more about MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display: https://apple.co/3WWaYg4

Stream “Surrender” by Labrinth on Apple Music: https://music.apple/Surrender

#MacBookPro #PROLED #Mac #LogicPro13

title: Created live on Mac: “Surrender” by Labrinth
